rec.name: Cart Payment Icons & Installment/Invoice Payment Bar
rec.status: Built — launched (documented, product image in catalog)

what.text: A payment bar placed directly under the checkout button in the cart (cart page and cart drawer). It shows a row of selectable payment-method icons (PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Sofort, etc.). Below the row is an installment/invoice message line, e.g. 'Bequem auf Raten zahlen' ('Pay comfortably in installments') with a Klarna or PayPal logo. The ticket asks for it to be built as its own section. The delivered build uses theme settings and snippets rather than a section-editor block.

why.text: Payment icons next to the checkout button reassure shoppers that their preferred, familiar payment method is accepted, which lowers payment anxiety at the decision point. The 'pay in installments / on invoice' message lowers the perceived price barrier and the risk of paying upfront. This is especially useful for higher-priced carts. Grayscale styling keeps the bar unobtrusive, while a colorful style raises brand recognition.

how.text: 1) Create the snippet ed-payment-bar.liquid. It renders payment_type_svg_tag icons for each enabled checkbox and applies a grayscale or colorful filter. 2) Create the snippet ed-klarna-custom-payment.liquid. It shows the Klarna or PayPal logo plus a configurable text line, with a font size and color setting. 3) Add the 'Styling of payment bar' schema to config/settings_schema.json. 4) Render both snippets in a wrapper div (.ed-payment-bar-cart) under the checkout button in the cart template and drawer. The installment line only renders if 'Show rate payment on cart page' is enabled. Cart settings were deliberately separated from the PDP settings, so the PDP bar is controlled in the product section. The dynamic installment amount shown in the second reference ('Pay over 3 interest-free payments of 19.97 €') comes from the Klarna On-Site Messaging app and cannot be hard-coded.

items: Background color of the bar (can be transparent)
Payment icon checkboxes: PayPal, Master, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Klarna Pay Later, Sofort, Bitcoin, Shopify Pay (recommended max 6 active)
Installment payment method logo: Klarna or PayPal

dependencies.text: No metafields needed. Uses theme settings (config/settings_schema.json) and Shopify's payment_type_svg_tag / payment_type_img_url. The dynamic Klarna installment calculation requires the Klarna On-Site Messaging app. Requires a Liquid code edit, so non-devs cannot install it. Klarna and Klarna Pay Later render the same icon, so enabling both shows Klarna twice (planned to be removed in v1.1). The PDP version has separate settings in the product section.

items: Share of orders paid with Klarna/installments

images.caption: Final design: payment icon row (PayPal, Mastercard, Visa, Amex, Klarna, Apple Pay, Sofort) under the checkout button, with a Klarna logo and installment/invoice text line below
Reference of the dynamic Klarna on-site messaging variant (installment amount calculated by the app)
Theme editor 'Styling of payment bar' settings: background color, border style, grayscale/colorful, icon toggles
Colorful, rounded variant with white background, shown on the product page with icon toggles and rate payment settings
Cart drawer showing the Klarna icon duplicated when Klarna-pay-later is enabled (known issue, v1.1)
Toggles for showing the installment payment line on product page and cart page
